Author: aki
Name: KittyUI Companion
Punchline: KittyUI inside the game: a live layout studio, plugin settings, themes, profiles, backups, macros and a plugin browser.
Description: The in-game half of KittyUI. Move and resize the plugins' elements and the game's own HUD over the real HUD, edit every plugin's settings in one place, recolour them with one palette, install UI themes, switch and save kitty collections, write macros, browse and update plugins by reading their repositories directly, and keep backups. Changes reach the plugins without a restart; the desktop app shares the same data. Does nothing on its own: KittyUI asks, the companion does, never in combat.
Changelog:
- KittyUI runs inside the game: studio over the real HUD (with the game's own HUD layout), settings, theme and UI themes, profiles, backups, plugins, macros
- DelvUI and DelvCD take settings without unloading; window positions, Penumbra's collections and the HUD layout apply while playing
- the plugin browser reads the repositories again on demand; a profile switched in game is followed
- the window in the desktop app's look; `/kitty`
- one editing session with the desktop app: unsent edits are kept as they are made and can be taken over or discarded on the other side, also after a crash
- settings: the game's HUD elements, Penumbra, Aetherment and DelvUI's auto-switch as pages; a search across every page; the quick window's pins are shared with the desktop app
- studio: the Replacements list (plugin element or the game's own, linked or not)
- profiles: a collection opened for editing without touching the game, then applied, saved or saved as new; EllesmereUI import
- plugins: the desktop app's queued changes, with Apply now; the desktop app's keep-or-revert question is asked in game too
- plugins page: a row's buttons fit at any window size and the whole row can be clicked; what a button started and how it ended is said above the tabs (errors in red, and in Dalamud's log); a greyed button says what it waits for
- DelvUI's and DelvCD's own elements follow a drag in the studio and any plain value changed on a settings page at once, before the file is written (can be turned off on the Companion page)
